title: How Recently an Air Ticket Fare Brands Booking Was Cancelled Bears on the Share Returned
content:
Where an Air Ticket Fare Brands booking stands cancelled, the share of its carrier-imposed taxes returned to the traveller is set by how long ago that cancellation was confirmed, counted in days from the confirmation to today.

## The ladder

| Where | The share returned is |
| --- | --- |
| the booking stands cancelled and its cancellation was confirmed within the last 90 days | 1, the full share |
| the booking stands cancelled and its cancellation was confirmed more than 90 days ago | 0.85, being 85 percent |
| in every other case | no such adjustment is made to the share |

Both rows turn on the booking standing cancelled. A booking standing in any other state falls outside the ladder whatever its dates, and a booking standing cancelled falls on one row or the other, there being no third possibility once the state holds.

## Boundary readings, on hypothetical dates

A cancellation confirmed exactly 90 days before today is within the last 90 days, so the full share of 1 is returned; a cancellation confirmed 91 days before today is more than 90 days old, and 0.85 is returned instead.

A booking whose cancellation was confirmed 200 days ago returns 85 percent of the figure; had the same booking been cancelled a week ago, the whole of it would be returned.
